notes.subject: win yettwanfalen
notes.rationale: נרדף (Pual participle of רדף, 'to pursue'): 'win yettwanfalen' (the one pursued/driven away) vs 'ayen yezrin' (that which passed away) — KJV 'requireth that which is past' vs JPS 'seeketh that which is pursued'.

notes.subject: היה / להיות / היה
notes.rationale: Repetition of hayah three times frames the verse — what was, what will be, already was; the circular echo is kept by yella/yili/yella.

notes.subject: yakan
notes.rationale: כבר literally 'extent of time, long ago' — rendered as adverb 'yakan' (already/formerly), losing the duration nuance.

notes.subject: d netta
notes.rationale: Hebrew הוא is emphatic pronoun; kabyle needs 'd netta' ('it is he/it') to carry the emphasis.

translation: Ayen i yellan, yakan yella; ayen ara yili, yakan yella-yakan; Elohim ad inadi ⟨את⟩ win yettwanfalen.
